title: US stocks are off to their worst start versus the global market since 1995
title_zh: 与全球市场相比，美国股市迎来 1995 年以来最糟糕的开局
summary: As US valuations and price-to-earnings ratios have surged, global markets have outperformed the S&P 500.
summary_zh: 随着美国估值和市盈率飙升，全球市场表现优于标准普尔 500 指数。

title: Wall Street Hunts for Bottom as S&P Retests ‘Rock Solid’ Support
title_zh: 标准普尔重新测试“坚如磐石”的支撑，华尔街追寻底部
summary: “If it was to fail now, that would be an indication that sentiment might be shifting more bearishly,” Colin Cieszynski, chief market strategist at SIA Wealth Management Inc., said by phone.
summary_zh: SIA Wealth Management Inc.首席市场策略师Colin Cieszynski在电话中表示：“如果现在失败，则表明市场情绪可能会变得更加悲观。”

title: Apple Decouples From Nasdaq as AI ‘Whack-a-Mole’ Grips Market
title_zh: 随着人工智能“打地鼠”占领市场，苹果与纳斯达克脱钩
summary: Its correlation with the benchmark has been on the decline since May, when it reached 0.92, as Apple’s decision to mostly sit out the AI arms race has turned it into an outlier compared with many of its rivals.
summary_zh: 自 5 月份以来，它与基准的相关性一直在下降，当时它达到了 0.92，因为苹果公司决定基本不参与人工智能军备竞赛，这使其与许多竞争对手相比成为一个异常值。

title: Gold price below $5,000 as investors wait on Fed guidance for clues
title_zh: 投资者等待美联储指引寻找线索，金价跌破 5,000 美元
summary: Markets currently expect the Fed to cut rates in June
summary_zh: 目前市场预期美联储将在六月降息

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: London hits fresh high as UK inflation fall increases odds of March interest rate cut
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：英国通胀下降增加 3 月份降息的可能性，伦敦指数创下新高
summary: A March quarter-point interest rate cut is now currently seen as an 81.5% chance, up from 77% last night, and around 65% last week.
summary_zh: 目前认为 3 月份降息四分之一个百分点的可能性为 81.5%，高于昨晚的 77% 和上周的 65% 左右。
